Thanks,

- 10:15–11:00 PT: Pen-test scope discussion and vendor handoff (Ben leads)
- 11:10–11:40 PT: DPA redline review & clarifications (Marissa leads)

If you prefer a single contiguous slot, we can also do 09:00–11:30 PT.

Please let me know whether the staggered approach or contiguous block works better for your team and confirm preferred date. For availability I can offer:

- Tue, June 8: 09:00–12:00 PT
- Wed, June 9: 09:00–12:00 PT
- Thu, June 10: 08:30–11:30 PT (fallback)

Prep notes / asks from our side:
- Please share the completed questionnaire (or the filled copy) and any pen-test vendor constraints.
- If you have a target scope (subnets, environments), add that to the questionnaire.
- Let us know who on your side will own evidence transfer (S3 link, secure SharePoint, or email zip).

I’ve attached an evidence mapping template and a draft DPA redline to speed the call. I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa internally to lead their sections.

Best,
